user_text: My VPN client says authentication failed after I changed my password.

triage.problem_type: VPN authentication fails after a password change.
triage.search_query: VPN client authentication failed after password change

retrieval.query: VPN client authentication failed after password change

chunks.text: If the VPN client reports Authentication failed, verify the username and current password, then reconnect.
chunks.title: VPN sign-in troubleshooting

chunks.text: After changing a password, sign out of the VPN client and enter the updated credentials.
chunks.title: Update VPN credentials

draft_answer.summary: The VPN client may still be using the password saved before your change.

steps.instruction: Sign out of the VPN client, enter your updated password, and reconnect.

draft_answer.escalate_if: Contact IT if authentication still fails.
draft_answer.final_message: The VPN client may still be using your old password. Sign out, enter your updated password, and reconnect. Contact IT if it still fails.
